lose.body:
%NAME% they call the %RANK%, you have doomed us all. Rome is leaderless without the Aquila. All hope is lost. The rebels go unpunished and the legions scatter. The people are terrified and your army has abandoned your cause. All because you wasted your time so carelessly.

Final Score: %SCORE%

win.body:
Rome is saved, %NAME%! You have crushed the rebels and recovered the Aquila of the Legions. Order is restored across the provinces.

History will remember the name of %NAME%, the %RANK%-who-saved us all.

You keep all the castles and your commission is tripled.

Final Score: %SCORE%

banners.chest_gold:
After scouring the area, you fall upon a hidden treasure cache. You may:
A) Take the %GOLD% gold.
B) Distribute the gold to the peasants, increasing your leadership by %LEADERSHIP%.
banners.chest_commission:
After surveying the area, you discover that it is rich in mineral deposits.

The Emperor rewards you for your find by increasing your weekly income by %POINTS%
banners.chest_spell_power: Traversing the area, you stumble upon a time worn cannister. Curious, you unstop the bottle, releasing a powerful genie who raises your Spell Power by %POINTS% and vanishes.
banners.chest_max_spells: A tribe of nomads greet you and your army warmly. Their shaman, in awe of your prowess, teaches you the secret of his tribe's magic. Your maximum spell capacity is increased by %POINTS%
banners.chest_new_spell:
You have captured a mischevious imp which has been terrorizing the region. In exchange for its release, you receive:

%COUNT% %SPELL% spell.
